summary: TIAN RUIXIANG HOLDINGS Ltd (TRX) filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination and rescission of a Share Exchange Agreement originally dated November 4, 2025, and closed on November 5, 2025. Under the termination, TRX's subsidiary VitaCare Limited returns 100% equity in Ren Talents Inc. to the original sellers, and 3,211,010 Class A ordinary shares held in escrow are cancelled and revert to authorized but unissued status. The termination is mutual and ab initio. No consideration or premium was exchanged. The board approved the rescission. Structural note: shares were never released from escrow. What to watch: Nasdaq listing status implications and potential future acquisition strategy.
